title: Smartwatch ECG: how to record it and show your doctor
also: sharing a watch ECG with a doctor
what: Some smartwatches can record a single-lead ECG in about half a minute. You can save the recording and show it to your doctor.
why: When a racing heart or skipped beats come on suddenly and pass before you see a doctor. A recording helps catch the moment.
duration: one recording usually takes about 30 seconds
tell_doctor: What the watch showed, and when
What you felt during the recording
A watch does not replace a standard ECG. Your doctor may order one too

prepare.title: Setup
prepare.text: Turn on the ECG feature in the watch app ahead of time and go through the tutorial.

prepare.title: Strap
prepare.text: The watch should sit snugly on your wrist, on clean, dry skin.

prepare.title: Position
prepare.text: During the recording, sit down, rest your arm on a table, and do not talk.

bring: Your watch and phone with the recordings
Recordings saved as PDF, if the app can do it
A diary of times and how you felt
steps: Open the ECG app on your watch
Touch the button or crown of the watch with a finger of your other hand
Stay still for about 30 seconds while it records
Add a note about how you feel
Save or export the recording as a PDF for your doctor
feel: You feel nothing. The watch only records
The recording may fail if your arm moves. Just try again
after: Show the recordings to your doctor along with your diary
Even if the watch says normal but you feel unwell, see a doctor
The watch does not make a diagnosis. Your doctor does
red_flags: Chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, or fainting: call emergency services. Do not waste time on a recording
A very fast heartbeat that does not stop

faq.q: Can I trust a watch ECG?
faq.a: It is a good clue for your doctor, but not a full ECG. Your doctor makes the final call.

faq.q: How do I show the recording to my doctor?
faq.a: Usually the phone app can save the recording as a PDF to send or print.

reminders.text: Doctor's visit tomorrow. Save your watch ECG recordings as PDF and bring your symptom diary.
